mutation: replace abort::<impl Drop for Abort>::drop with ()
source: panic!("dcbor aborted: a scope or cleanup step could not continue");
rationale: Without the inner panic, abort unwinds instead of aborting; it aborts all the same wherever it is reachable. Called from the terminal drain on a refused cleanup, the unwind passes the drain's AbortOnUnwind guard, whose drop calls abort while unwinding, a panic while panicking, which aborts (the abort witness's defective-record child dies of SIGABRT under this mutant). Called from an AbortOnUnwind guard, the drain's or a release observer's (Reservation::drop), it already runs while unwinding. Its other callers are unreachable: release_last's check after the last reference's drain, which runs with no other holder and so cannot leave a record outstanding, and add_reference past isize::MAX live references.
scope: The no_std build of the crate's abort; a new caller of abort outside an AbortOnUnwind guard, other than the two unreachable ones, reopens it.
